daily.topThemeBody: Campus network infrastructure is being argued as an enrollment variable, not a back-office one, and the same logic runs through K-12 observability, literacy diagnostics, and Ed-Fi's attendance and transfer work. The unglamorous layer is where the AI promises get cashed or bounced.

heroWeek.themeBody: The recurring K-12 and campus IT message is that data governance, observability and an AI bill of materials come before the AI deployment, not after it. Districts collecting everything still can't say what their data means.
